context_purpose: The crematorium counter must confirm the applicant is a rightful next of kin before releasing a cremation permit.

norm_violation_today.reason: Siblings' IDs, addresses and half-sibling status go well beyond what is needed to establish the applicant's kin tier.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Cannot settle disputes among equal-rank relatives or detect objections from other heirs, which a full transcript lets staff check.

transmission_check.reason: Funeral rules likely require a kinship document on file, and I cannot tell whether an attested kin-tier claim would be accepted.

context_purpose: The party chapter wants only genuine members to get the member-priced ticket, one per event.

norm_violation_today.reason: A venue or agent receiving ID and membership photos learns members' party affiliation and attendance pattern, which is sensitive political information outside its role.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Little; the agent cannot contact the member or check identity beyond the ticket, which it does not need.

transmission_check.reason: No legal duty appears to require the venue to hold member identity; it is the agent's own habit.

context_purpose: The platform must ensure listed stalls are lawfully permitted to sell prepared food.

norm_violation_today.reason: Home address, ID number and full product list exceed the single fact of a current permit, and outsourced reviewers see them.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The platform may still need merchant identity for tax, payouts and consumer disputes, which a permit-validity proof does not supply.

transmission_check.reason: Platform identity collection for payouts or tax may be legally required, so the full scan may be collected anyway.

context_purpose: The union needs to confirm only paid-up members vote, once, in a strike poll.

norm_violation_today.reason: Rider account IDs and earnings screenshots are not needed to verify union membership and expose workers to platform retaliation.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Nothing material; the union already knows its own members, and the proof covers membership and one vote.

transmission_check.reason: The union sets its own ballot rules, so no outside duty requires the screenshots.

context_purpose: The bank must release a deceased depositor's funds only to heirs entitled to the amount claimed.

norm_violation_today.reason: The bank keeps the whole family tree and non-claiming relatives' data long after releasing the funds.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Cannot show wills, disclaimers, other heirs' consent or the full estate, which banks usually need to protect themselves from competing claims.

transmission_check.reason: Banks are expected to keep inheritance paperwork for audit and liability, and I cannot confirm a regulator would accept a threshold attestation.

context_purpose: The operator must register a prepaid SIM user and confirm a lawful stay so SIMs are not activated fraudulently.

norm_violation_today.reason: Collecting passport details at real-name registration matches the norms of this regulated context.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The operator still needs a retained identity record for registration, which an entry-status predicate does not replace.

transmission_check.reason: Real-name registration rules appear to require the operator to keep identity data, so a predicate-only proof would not satisfy it.

context_purpose: The dormitory operator must give beds and door access only to workers of its contracted employers who are currently employed.

norm_violation_today.reason: Broker front-desk staff seeing permit copies, passport numbers and salary slips is wider than a gate-access and bed-rate check needs.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: Little; the operator loses the paper trail of employer letters but already holds employer contracts.

transmission_check.reason: Foreign-worker housing rules may require records on file, and I cannot say whether a token would be accepted.

context_purpose: The telecom shop must identify non-citizen subscribers and avoid contracts that outlast the holder's right to stay.

norm_violation_today.reason: Identification at signup is legitimate, but re-collecting and keeping copies at every renewal may be more than needed.

purpose_sufficiency.lost: The initial full identification still has to happen, so the proof only helps with renewals.

transmission_check.reason: Subscriber registration likely demands retained ID at signup, though renewals may be more flexible.
